scope_freeze.exception_rule: Only a reproduced P0/P1 correction may replace one equivalent concept one-for-one with a recorded deletion, dependency impact, acceptance delta, and no increase in WIP or release ancestry.

execution_frontier.rationale: The completed R0.4.j, R2.2.f, R4.1, R5.1/R5.3, and R4.2.a-d evidence is preserved. The current focus is R4.2.e package/registry/VCS authority; finish its coherent transaction, then the R2/R3 prerequisites, R4.2.f-g and R4.3-R4.5, and remaining Core agent/service/package/assurance/product work through exact reviewed R9.4.f. Select the first start-ready frontier candidate so a blocked downstream anchor cannot stall its prerequisite; the continuation-complete anchors cover every unfinished Core ancestor and exclude post-Core work. One repository-changing GenesisCode transaction owns the lane through Core. The signed handoff activates F2.a-r Foundation first; F2.r activates the finite R8.3.a-b seed including its still-open web/tool/product-assurance prerequisites; R8.3.b then activates isolated GenesisBench, GenesisChallenge, later Foundry expansion, broader applications, optional packs, and F1/F3/F4. F2.y additionally waits for R8.5.s and F2.z for its full sequential ancestry. Genesis Model implementation waits for R8.5.t; R8.5.p assembles a candidate, R8.5.q integrates it, and R8.5.r independently evaluates and releases it. These handoffs do not grant completion authority.

allowed_parallel_lanes.description: One separately provisioned, read-only conformance or reproduction observation may run beside the selected GenesisCode production task.
conditions: it directly satisfies the selected GenesisCode task's declared evidence contract and cannot become unrelated assurance or another product's work
it runs on separately provisioned compute and storage and cannot consume the active task's local CPU, memory, disk, network, lock, or agent-attention budget
it cannot modify repository files, generated authorities, release state, or the active production transaction
it exercises only frozen GenesisCode inputs and independently reports pass, fail, unknown, or infrastructure failure
it performs no target-model inference, benchmark custody or commissioning, result publication, Foundry implementation, or Genesis Model work
it cannot authorize completion, promotion, capability, policy, signing, or release

negative_controls: reject roadmap/manifest coverage or generated-view drift
low.rollback: Revert the reviewed source change, regenerate derived views, and preserve the rejected diff as evidence.

negative_controls: reject missing prerequisites, acceptance evidence, or source identities
reject undeclared output and compatibility changes
medium.rollback: Restore the prior compatible artifact or profile, rerun its guards, and retain the failed candidate for diagnosis.

negative_controls: reject stale identities, unknown fields, host-specific paths, and evidence produced by update commands
reject capability, policy, format, or resource broadening without an explicit reviewed contract
high.rollback: Fail closed, keep the prior verified authority reachable, reverse only through a reviewed semantic patch, and preserve all mismatch evidence.

negative_controls: reject any semantic, authority, seal, replay, capability, bootstrap, or release-policy bypass
reject self-verification, unsigned authority changes, and incomplete independent evidence
critical.rollback: Fail closed before authority changes, retain the last independently verified implementation and trust roots, revoke affected artifacts when necessary, and require incident evidence before resumption.
